name: Purity
source:
An immature goddess whose fear of heights prevents her from flying freely in the sky. By mistake, she had fallen down to earth from the heavens. When she hides her wings, she can easily pass for a normal human woman. She has a cheerful and openhearted personality.

The Great Goddess has given her strict orders not to come into contact with the people of the earthly world, so it would seem that she's hiding by a lake deep in the forest so as not to be seen...

[translated from [url=http://dl.getchu.com/i/item1000683]Getchu[/url]]
